trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer for database connection pooling
trello.desc: Owner: Raj. Task: Set up a load test mirroring the dashboard's query pattern to benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against the current Postgres setup. Focus on measuring p95 latency with and without PgBouncer to address connection contention issues. Deadline: Bring results and numbers to the next product sync.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Owner: Tom. Task: Correct the typo 'recieve' to 'receive' in the onboarding email subject line. Push the fix through the email template repository and get it re-approved. Deadline: Today.

trello.name: Update roadmap documentation regarding dark mode
trello.desc: Owner: Tom. Task: Update the roadmap document to remove dark mode from 'Q3 committed' and move it under the September design-system upgrade line. This ensures sales aligns with the decision not to build dark mode standalone this cycle. Deadline: Immediately after the meeting.
